matrix.title: Role Permissions Matrix
matrix.desc: Every action across the platform is protected according to the staff member's assigned role. Below is the scope of each profile:
matrix.c1Desc: View daily court availability and validate player arrival at reception
matrix.c2Desc: Register direct in-person bookings at the counter
matrix.c3Desc: Browse booking history and export accounting reports
matrix.c4Desc: Verify payment receipts, billing, and settlements
matrix.c5Desc: Manually update the reference exchange rate
matrix.c6Desc: Create and edit sports venues, courts, and hourly rates
matrix.c7Desc: Configure opening/closing hours and operational blocks
matrix.c8Desc: Invite team members, assign venues, and manage privileges
matrix.c9Desc: Manage sports, surfaces, amenities, and support tickets

sessions.title: Active Sessions & Connected Devices
sessions.desc: Real-time inspection of connected devices. You can remotely sign out sessions for security.
sessions.confirmRevokeAll: Are you sure you want to sign out all active sessions? All users will need to sign in again.
sessions.empty: There are no active sessions at this moment.

modalInvite.title: Invite Staff Member
modalInvite.desc: Enter the team member's details, assign their role, and set their work scope.
modalInvite.scopeHintValidator: A Validator operates exclusively at the physical venue assigned to them.
modalInvite.scopeHintOrgWide: This role has access across all venues in the organization.
modalInvite.scopeHintPlatform: This role has global access across the YoReservo platform.
modalInvite.magicLinkHint: The staff member will receive a secure email link to activate their account and set their password.
modalInvite.policyDesc: Meets policy: Uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and symbols (8-72 chars).
modalInvite.errorVenueRequired: You must select a specific venue for the Validator / Reception role.

modalEdit.title: Edit Staff Member Privileges
modalEdit.desc: Update institutional role, assigned venue scope, and account status.
modalEdit.scopeHintValidator: Select the specific venue where this validator will work.
modalEdit.scopeHintOrgWide: This role automatically operates across all venues in the organization.
modalEdit.errorVenueRequired: You must assign a specific venue for a Validator / Reception.

modalReset.title: Reset Password
modalReset.desc: Generate a new temporary secure password for the staff member
modalReset.confirmDesc: Upon confirmation, the system will generate a secure temporary password that you can copy and share with the staff member.
